title: Game Speed Optimized
description: Game Speed Optimized is a modpack containing purely optimization mods to solve Minecraft's horrific optimization problem
body:
### Description
A stripped back Fabric modpack focused on FPS and smooth gameplay removing bloat while adding lightweight optimizations for faster load times stable performance and a the Minecraft experience we were never given.
### Performance Increase:
- Vanilla - 94 FPS
- GSO - 632 FPS
- 572.34% performance increase overall
### Mods included:
- Fabric API
- Sodium
- Lithium
- Ferrite Core
- Immidiately fast
- Entity Culling
- Dynamic FPS
- Krypton
- ScalableLux
- ModernFix-mVUS
- Mod Menu
- Mod Loading Screen
- Reese's Sodium Options
